evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt to enable the -Wmissing-noreturn compiler warning flag and suppress Clang warnings on annotated lambdas.
rationale: Enables the -Wmissing-noreturn compiler warning flag in CMake and annotates non-returning functions to prevent compiler analysis false positives. While systematic warning enforcement improves code hygiene and avoids spurious missing-return diagnostics, it is developer-focused and reasonably deferrable.
